rows.title: employee work assignments handling procedure
rows.body: [SUPERSEDED 2025] employee work assignments records verified in status "in_progress" must be moved to status "assigned". This document may be outdated.

rows.title: employee work assignments handling procedure (rev. 2)
rows.body: [CURRENT — effective 2026-06-01, supersedes all prior versions] For employee work assignments records verified in status "in_progress": if the record's department_id is "4", move it to status "completed"; otherwise move it to status "assigned". Apply exactly one transition.
